title: Who did it, and what has happened
label: ch:gu-who-did-it-and-what-has-happened
canDo: I can say who did something with a name or a noun (Aruṇe cā pīdhī, Mīrāe patra lakhyo), and say what has happened and what had happened (gayo che, karyũ hatũ).

payoff.summary: Complete GU-R273-who-did-it: say who did something, and what has and had happened.
